arguments.value: 54-year-old woman with newly diagnosed symptomatic IgG-kappa multiple myeloma (ISS III, R-ISS II) presenting with severe pneumococcal pneumonia, anemia, renal impairment, and 90% marrow plasma cell infiltration with t(11;14). She had poor response to initial VRD/Dara-VRD complicated by recurrent pneumonia and sulfonamide allergy, then achieved a rapid, deeper response to second-line isatuximab-carfilzomib-dexamethasone with IVIG prophylaxis and is now planned for autologous stem cell transplant.
